Delhi-NCR sports activities banned due to air pollution

The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) has directed schools in Delhi-NCR to suspend all physical sports activities and competitions during November and December due to severe air pollution. This directive applies to schools in Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh. The measure aims to protect students from the health risks associated with poor air quality during the winter months.
